# Function to calculate mean and 95% CI
  mean_ci <- function(x, conf.level = 0.95) {
    m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(length(na.omit(x)))
    alpha <- 1 - conf.level
    error_margin <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = length(na.omit(x)) - 1) * se
    return(data.frame(y = m, ymin = m - error_margin, ymax = m + error_margin))
  }
